# ThreeUI Community (vendored excerpt)

`dotMatrix.ts` is adapted from ThreeUI Community's Dot Matrix background
(`src/shaders/dot-matrix/dotMatrixShaders.ts` in github.com/MengTo/threeui at
`68802d5428071ada5c20db8094b1649e6bb770ed`), MIT licensed, Copyright (c) 2026 Meng To. See `LICENSE`.

Changes for Open Computer: WebGL 1 with an explicit precision line, no three.js (a raw full-screen triangle),
the pointer offset removed, the fixed cyan replaced by a theme colour uniform, and a much slower, fainter pulse.
Only this shader source is copied; no ThreeUI assets, fonts or components.
